# Pre-processing datasets for Rapid workflow

This workflow includes importing and organizing of datasets for the rapid workflow to allow for quick re-runs of the rapid reports and a cleaner workflow.

```{r}
source("setup.R")

water_supplies <- get_wsd(rapid = TRUE)
```

# Create File Structure

Create folders if they don't already exist

```{r}
if(!dir.exists("data/rapid")) {
  dir.create("data/rapid")
}

# folder for park-level data
if(!dir.exists("data/rapid/park")) {
  dir.create("data/rapid/park")
}

# folders for each park code
walk(sort(parks$UNIT_CODE), function(x){
  if(!dir.exists(paste0("data/rapid/park", x))) {
    dir.create(paste0("data/rapid/park", x))
  }
})

# folder for conus or US wide data
if(!dir.exists("data/rapid/all")) {
  dir.create("data/rapid/all")
}

# folder for indicators input datasets
if(!dir.exists("data/rapid/inputs")) {
  dir.create("data/rapid/inputs")
}

# folder for indicator output datasets
if(!dir.exists("data/rapid/outputs")) {
  dir.create("data/rapid/outputs")
}

# folder for coastal component input datasets
if(!dir.exists("data/rapid/inputs/coast_comp")) {
  dir.create("data/rapid/inputs/coast_comp")
}


```

# Fire Probability Data

Combine all Gao et al. files and save final file to feed into `calc_fire_exposure()`

```{r}
# read in input datasets
pyromes <- st_read("data/all/usfs_fire/Pyromes-RDS-2020-0020/Data/Pyromes_CONUS_20200206.shp") |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  sf::st_transform(4326)


# GAO 2021 FIRE PROBABILITY
crosswalk <- read_csv("data/all/usfs_fire/fire_projections_gao_2021/gcm_crosswalk.csv")

# Back-casted GCMs, compared against GridMet. Really just need GridMet.
fireprob_historic <- read_csv("data/all/usfs_fire/fire_projections_gao_2021/tables3-fireprob-hist.csv")

# Midcentury is defined as the avg. across 2040-2070:
delta_fireprob <- read_csv("data/all/usfs_fire/fire_projections_gao_2021/tables12-45-midcentury.csv") |>
  pivot_longer(-PYROME, names_to = "gao") |>
  left_join(crosswalk, by = "gao") |>
  mutate(GCM = paste0(GCM, ".rcp45")) |>
  # do same thing on the 85 CFs, then bind together:
  bind_rows(
    read_csv(
      "data/all/usfs_fire/fire_projections_gao_2021/tables6-85-midcentury.csv"
    ) |>
      tidyr::pivot_longer(-PYROME, names_to = "gao", values_to = "value") |>
      left_join(crosswalk, by = "gao") |>
      mutate(GCM = paste0(GCM, ".rcp85"))
  ) |>
  # join historic data by pyrome:
  left_join(fireprob_historic, by = "PYROME") |>
  # Description: "The probability of a fire increases/decreases by `delta_fp` percent."
  #mutate(delta_fp = 100 * ((value - GridMet)/GridMet))
  # new method, pulling each model's specific hind cast value instead of Gridmet
  rowwise() |>
  # No historic value for NorESM1 so using ensemble mean for that one
  mutate(delta_fp = 100 * ((value - get(
    ifelse(gao == "NorESM1", "ensemblemean", gao)
  )) / get(
    ifelse(gao == "NorESM1", "ensemblemean", gao)
  ))) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  select(PYROME, GCM, delta_fp)

```

Save files

```{r}
write_csv(delta_fireprob, "data/rapid/inputs/fire_probability_change.csv")

st_write(pyromes, "data/rapid/inputs/pyromes.gpkg", append = FALSE)
```

# Process LOCA2 Files

### Air Temperature

```{r}
temperature_data <- list.files("data/all/loca2_mwbm/", full.names = TRUE, pattern = "tasmin|tasmax|lusu|temperature|temp")

walk(temperature_data, ~ {
  if (grepl("tasmin", .x, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    process_loca2_mwbm(nc_path = .x,
                       water_supplies = water_supplies,
                       var = "tasmin_tavg",
                       grab_nearest = TRUE,
                       historical = c("1979-10-01", "2024-12-31"),
                       future = c("2034-10-01", "2100-12-31"),
                       output_dir = "data/rapid/inputs/loca2_temperature_water_supplies/")
  }
  
  if (grepl("tasmax", .x, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    process_loca2_mwbm(nc_path = .x,
                       water_supplies = water_supplies,
                       var = "tasmax_tavg",
                       grab_nearest = TRUE,
                       historical = c("1979-10-01", "2024-12-31"),
                       future = c("2034-10-01", "2100-12-31"),
                       output_dir = "data/rapid/inputs/loca2_temperature_water_supplies/")
  }
})
```

### Runoff

```{r}
runoff_data <- list.files("data/all/loca2_mwbm/", full.names = TRUE, pattern = "*runoff")

# Process all NetCDF files using helper function
walk(runoff_data, ~process_loca2_mwbm(.x,
                                      output_dir = "data/rapid/inputs/loca2_runoff_water_supplies/",
                                      water_supplies = water_supplies |> select(park_unit, wsd_source_id),
                                      var = "runoff",
                                      grab_nearest = TRUE,
                                      historical = c("1979-01-01", "2014-12-31"),
                                      future = c("2015-01-01", "2100-12-31")))

# took 24 minutes
```

### Precipitation

```{r}
precip_data <- grep("livneh", list.files("data/all/loca2_mwbm/", full.names = TRUE, pattern = "pr_|precip|pr."), value = TRUE, invert = TRUE)

# Process all NetCDF files using helper function
walk(precip_data, ~try(process_loca2_mwbm(.x,
                                          output_dir = "data/rapid/inputs/loca2_precipitation_water_supplies/",
                                          water_supplies = water_supplies |> select(park_unit, wsd_source_id),
                                          var = "pr",
                                          grab_nearest = TRUE,
                                          historical = c("1979-01-01", "2014-12-31"),
                                          future = c("2015-01-01", "2100-12-31"))))

# took 57 minutes
```

### Consecutive Dry and Wet Periods and Flood Metrics

```{r}
precip_period_data <- list.files("data/all/loca_cmip6_ext_precip_products/",
                                 full.names = TRUE,
                                 recursive = TRUE,
                                 pattern = "\\.nc$")

walk(precip_period_data, ~ process_extreme_precip_data(nc_path = .x,
                                                       water_supplies = water_supplies |>
                                                         select(park_unit, wsd_source_id),
                                                       # Only Dry Tortugas has no LOCA2 data in its 3 x 3
                                                       # block; the nearest cell with data is 178-181 km away
                                                       # on the Florida mainland, inside the 200 km default.
                                                       grab_nearest = TRUE,
                                                       output_dir = "data/rapid/inputs/loca_cmip6_precip_periods_water_supplies/",
                                                       overwrite = TRUE,
                                                       verbose = TRUE))
```

### Temperature-Threshold Metrics (Warm-Water Surrogates)

Extract the three yearly temperature-threshold metrics used by
`calc_temp_threshold_exposure()` from the CMIP6-LOCA2 thresholds collection
(Alder 2024, <https://doi.org/10.5066/P13OV6GY>): `SU` (summer days, maximum
above 25 C), `GDD10` (growing degree days above 10 C) and `GSL` (growing season
length). Each metric is one `.tar.gz` with a NetCDF file per model, scenario and
run, holding the historical run (1950-2014) and the scenario (2015-2100) in one
series. The archives are extracted to a local temporary folder, not the synced
data folder (GDD10 alone is about 9 GB), and each file is deleted once
processed. Files already processed are skipped without extracting them.

```{r}
temp_threshold_archives <- list.files("data/all/loca_cmip6_ext_temperature_products/",
                                      full.names = TRUE,
                                      pattern = "\\.tar\\.gz$")

walk(temp_threshold_archives, ~ process_temp_threshold_metrics(path = .x,
                                                               water_supplies = water_supplies |>
                                                                 select(park_unit, wsd_source_id),
                                                               # So Dry Tortugas gets SFlorida data.
                                                               grab_nearest = TRUE,
                                                               output_dir = "data/rapid/inputs/loca_cmip6_temp_threshold_water_supplies/",
                                                               overwrite = TRUE,
                                                               verbose = TRUE))
```

### Drought Data

Aggregates the gridded data above to single monthly value for each water supply for SPEI drought calculations.

```{r}
process_drought_data(water_supplies,
                     precip_data = "data/rapid/inputs/loca2_precipitation_water_supplies/",
                     pet_data = "data/rapid/inputs/loca2_pet_water_supplies/",
                     hindcast = TRUE,
                     historical = c("1979", "2014"),
                     future = c("2015", "2065"),
                     water_year = TRUE,
                     output_dir = "data/rapid/inputs/",
                     verbose = TRUE)

```

# Process Coastal Site's Geometries

```{r}
process_coastal_geometry(
  water_supplies = water_supplies,
  cusp_dir_path = here("data", "all", "coast_comp_data", "NOAA_CUSP"),
  ncpu = 6,
  max_coast_dist_m = 50000,
  save = TRUE,
  output_dir = here("data", "rapid", "inputs", "coast_comp"),
  verbose = TRUE
)
```

# Process Sea Level Rise Inundation Data

```{r}
inundation_data <- process_inundation_data(
  coast_dir_path = here("data", "all", "coast_comp_data"), 
  water_supplies = water_supplies, 
  save           = TRUE, 
  output_dir     = here("data", "rapid", "inputs", "coast_comp"))
# took under 5 minutes
```

# Process Groundwater Depth Data

Extracts modeled water table depth at each water supply point from the CONUS-wide 
RF groundwater depth model (Zenodo 18504963), read from the local copy downloaded 
to `data/all/groundwater_sensitivity/`.

```{r}
process_groundwater_depth(water_supplies = water_supplies,
                          save = TRUE,
                          output_dir = "data/rapid/inputs/groundwater_depth/")
```


# Process Water Rights Indicator Data [Aqueduct V4.0]

```{r}
process_waterrightsindicator_data(
  water_supplies,
  gdb_path   = here("data", "all", "aqueduct_v4",
                    "Aqueduct40_waterrisk_download_Y2023M07D05", "GDB",
                    "Aq40_Y2023D07M05.gdb"),
  save_intermediate = TRUE,
  save       = TRUE,
  output_dir = here("data", "rapid", "inputs", "WaterRightsIndicator"),
  verbose    = TRUE) 
```
